title: The Blue Jay owned by Bob Montgomery 1966-1976
description: The Blue Jay, with its classic soda fountain and lunch service, was a local spot that evoked childhood memories. Stepping inside transported you back to a carefree day, whether you were dropping in for a treat after skating or enjoying a special outing with friends. It wasn’t just about the food or ice cream floats; it was about reliving happy memories. The Blue Jay was owned by Bob Montgomery in 1967 and later by Brian Hatfield in 1976 before being torn down in 1982.
